//: The HARNESS typecheck program. `tsconfig.json` includes only `src/**/*.ts`, so every file
under `script/` — the whole m14 gate machinery — has never been in a TypeScript program.
That is not a theoretical gap. `completeness-inventory.ts` declares
"markdown", "scss" ]` — three bare strings spliced into a typed array by a merge — and tsc
reported nothing, because the file was not being checked. The gate then crashed at runtime
with `c.id.padEnd` on a string instead of reporting its section-A failure, so a merge defect
was invisible to the type checker AND to the gate it broke.
A separate program rather than widening `tsconfig.json`, for a measured reason: the src
program is on the hot path of every edit, and adding ~60 more files (several of them 20k+
lines) to it costs time on every typecheck to buy a check that runs far less often. This
config is invoked by script/m14/verify-harness-typecheck.ts, which is the gate.
`script/m14/tmp/**` is EXCLUDED, and the reason is specific rather than precautionary: it
holds scratch probes AND copies of other lanes' fixture data, and the fixture data is
class-expression-members.ts` contains a constructor in an object literal, which is a
TypeScript syntax error by design. Including it would report three permanent failures that
are properties of the test corpus, not of the code.
//compilerOptions: tsconfig.json sets rootDir to src, and every file under script/ violates it with TS6059. The harness program spans both trees, so its root is the repo root. rootDir belongs INSIDE compilerOptions — placing it at the top level is silently ignored and tsc answers TS6258, which is a wasted round trip for anyone extending this config later.
